item.text:
Implemented FIFO costing in [costing.py](/Users/jimmynguyen/.cache/codex-practices-lab/work/20261118-055039-plan-t13-c51a/repo/src/shoplib/costing.py:14). Sales consume oldest lots first; returns use the latest sale’s half-up rounded average cost, append after existing lots, and enforce that sale’s remaining returnable quantity. Invalid operations raise `ShopError`, a `ValueError` subclass.

Added behavior and error case coverage in [test_costing.py](/Users/jimmynguyen/.cache/codex-practices-lab/work/20261118-055039-plan-t13-c51a/repo/tests/test_costing.py:9).
